technical-summary: The runtime heat guard refused every production start with the live placement policy on, right after the start canary: the first read of the engine's periodic histogram can be an authentic file that holds no route counts yet, which was reported as unsafe. histogram_verdict now returns a new pending verdict for exactly that case (authentic nonce/proof/shape, padding zero, all counts zero) and the startup check waits for the first counted snapshot for the declared histogram period or the policy's allowed heat age, whichever is longer; every other unsafe cause still refuses at once and the steady-state poll is unchanged. Every non-fresh verdict now carries a reason that the refusal text names (it used to print only the number). The model's 49 routed layers including the MTP layer are accepted and counts beyond them stay padding.
user-summary-candidate: Production starts with the live placement policy on no longer refuse at the heat check right after the canary, and a refusal now says why.
